name: Bathyal-Apse

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: An atom-forged theocracy that believes the planet is a sealed reliquary, and forbids its opening.

description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait bioluminescent seas, and everything the light never reaches.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Settlement lights trace the coastlines and river-veins, visible from high orbit.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The ore-body estimates keep being revised upward, which keeps the gun-runner schedules full.
